Olga / team —

Attached are redlines to the venue agreement (venue_contract_draft_v3_redlines.pdf). Short summary:
- Insurance: $1M is standard; suggest adding a clause requiring venue to carry occupational hazard coverage for onsite staff.
- Indemnity: convert venue unilateral indemnity to mutual but limit to gross negligence and willful misconduct; carve out liability for inhibited attendee disclosures.
- Data retention: remove open-ended attendee-data retention; set a 30-day retention for guest CSV and require secure deletion and confirmation.
- Cancellation: propose a sliding scale (25% within 21–14 days, 50% within 14–7 days, 75% <7 days) to provide more flexibility.

I can send the DocuSign package once the venue accepts the redlines. Also recommend a simple mutual NDA (one page) between Redwood and VenueCove; I've attached a template and can execute on your behalf.

Attachment: venue_contract_draft_v3_redlines.pdf
DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.net/Envelope/SignRequest/EVN-98234

Best,
